title.narrative: EU for the Rule of Law - Technical Capacity Facility for the Implementation of Action Plans for Chapters 23 and 24

description.narrative:
In the Strategy for “A credible enlargement perspective for an enhanced EU engagement with the Western Balkans 2018", the European Commission reaffirmed the strong focus on the principle of "fundamentals first" in the accession process. Core issues of the rule of law, fundamental rights, and strengthening democratic institutions remain key priorities. The pace of Serbia’s EU accession negotiations depends in particular on the assessed progress within the rule of law area and especially on the fulfillment of the requirements stipulated in Chapters 23 (Anti-corruption and Fundamental Rights) and 24 (Chapter 24 - Fight Against Serious and Organised Crime). 

UNOPS, as implementing partner, will be responsible for conducting the procurement process, in accordance with its procurement policy and regulations. The procurement priorities will be defined on the basis of inputs from two complementary Facilities, in close collaboration with the national stakeholders, and approved by the Contracting Authority (EU). Within the procurement process, UNOPS will conduct procurement planning, research market, and define requirements with inputs and in collaboration with the national beneficiaries. UNOPS will provide subject matter experts to ensure development of quality specifications in cooperation with experts engaged by Facilities for Chapter 23 and 24 and beneficiary.
